system.v1.AffectedService.description: AffectedService is a part of the platform a status event affects.
system.v1.AffectedService.title: AffectedService

system.v1.GetVersionResponse.description: GetVersionResponse identifies the exact build the environment serves.

commit.description: Full 40-character lowercase hexadecimal source revision of the build.
commit.title: commit

environment.description:
Environment that answered: "devnet", "testnet" or "mainnet", or "local"
 for a development stack.
environment.title: environment

version.description:
Version of the exact build. A release reports its version in
 MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH form, such as "0.10.0". A build made after a release
 appends the number of source revisions since that release and "g" with
 the first 12 hexadecimal digits of its own revision, such as
 "0.10.0-12-g4e21a2f09670": 12 revisions after release 0.10.0. Releases
 before mainnet are 0.MINOR.PATCH; mainnet starts at 1.0.0.
version.title: version

system.v1.GetVersionResponse.title: GetVersionResponse

events.description:
Matching events ordered by start_time descending, then id descending:
 the latest start first.
events.title: events

nextPageToken.description: Cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.
nextPageToken.title: next_page_token

system.v1.StatusEvent.description: StatusEvent is one scheduled maintenance or incident.

assets.description:
Codes of the affected assets, such as "SOL", in ascending order. Empty
 when the event is not limited to particular assets.
assets.title: assets

cancelledAt.description: When the event was cancelled. Set only when state is CANCELLED.
cancelledAt.title: cancelled_at

detailsUrl.description:
HTTPS link to a long-form announcement about the event, at most 2048
 characters. Omitted when the event has none.
detailsUrl.title: details_url

endTime.description:
End of the window, after start_time: when the maintenance is expected to
 end, or when the incident ended or is expected to end. Always set for
 MAINTENANCE. Omitted for an INCIDENT with no expected end yet.
endTime.title: end_time

id.description:
Stable opaque 64-bit identifier. It never changes when the event is
 updated.

Public ID, as a base58 string.
id.title: id

impact.description:
Severity of an INCIDENT. IMPACT_UNSPECIFIED for MAINTENANCE and for an
 incident not yet assessed.
impact.title: impact

markets.description:
Symbols of the affected markets, such as "BTC-USDT", in ascending order.
 Empty when the event is not limited to particular markets.
markets.title: markets

message.description:
Plain-text summary for users, at most 4000 characters. It can be revised;
 progress notes are in updates.
message.title: message

services.description: Affected parts of the platform. Never empty.
services.title: services

startTime.description:
Start of the window: when the maintenance begins, or when the incident
 began. It no longer changes once the window has started.
startTime.title: start_time

state.description: State at the time of the response.
state.title: state

updatedAt.description:
Time of the latest change to the event, a new progress note included. Its
 state moving with the clock is not a change.
updatedAt.title: updated_at

updates.description: Progress notes, oldest first. At most 50.
updates.title: updates

system.v1.StatusEvent.title: StatusEvent

system.v1.StatusEventImpact.description: StatusEventImpact is how severely an incident affects users.
system.v1.StatusEventImpact.title: StatusEventImpact

system.v1.StatusEventState.description:
StatusEventState is where a status event stands at the time of the
 response. It follows from the event's window: SCHEDULED before start_time,
 IN_PROGRESS from start_time until end_time, and COMPLETED from end_time on.
 A cancelled event is CANCELLED whatever its window.
system.v1.StatusEventState.title: StatusEventState

system.v1.StatusEventUpdate.description:
StatusEventUpdate is one progress note posted on a status event. Notes are
 never edited or removed.

id.description:
Position of the note on its event: 1 for the first, then increasing by 1.
 Unique within the event and never reused.
id.title: id

message.description: Plain-text note for users, at most 4000 characters.
message.title: message

system.v1.StatusEventUpdate.title: StatusEventUpdate

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

info.description:
Public trading API for market makers and integrators.
Connect RPC over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 with JSON and Protobuf.
info.title: Polyester API

get.description: List scheduled maintenance and incidents, the latest start first. With no states, it lists current and upcoming events.

parameters.description: Kinds to include. Empty means all.
parameters.name: kinds

schema.description: Kinds to include. Empty means all.
schema.title: kinds

parameters.description: Maximum events to return. 0 means the default of 50; maximum 200.
parameters.name: limit

schema.description: Maximum events to return. 0 means the default of 50; maximum 200.
schema.title: limit

parameters.description:
Opaque, keyset-backed, exclusive cursor from a previous response. Bound
 to states and kinds, and to the start time and id of the last event
 returned. Reuse it only with the same states and kinds. States follow
 the clock, so an event that changes state between two pages can be
 missing from both or appear on both; match events by id.
parameters.name: pageToken

schema.description:
Opaque, keyset-backed, exclusive cursor from a previous response. Bound
 to states and kinds, and to the start time and id of the last event
 returned. Reuse it only with the same states and kinds. States follow
 the clock, so an event that changes state between two pages can be
 missing from both or appear on both; match events by id.
schema.title: page_token

parameters.description:
States to include. Empty means SCHEDULED and IN_PROGRESS: current and
 upcoming events.
parameters.name: states

schema.description:
States to include. Empty means SCHEDULED and IN_PROGRESS: current and
 upcoming events.
schema.title: states
